subject: Protocol 2 hardening migration started without interrupting active R&D
body: Primary reconciled live repository state before hardening. The BenefitFlow R&D gate is ACTIVE_USER_STARTED and immutable research/forum work already exists. Protocol 2 therefore uses a non-destructive migration: existing v1 agents may finish already-claimed work, while new agents/new claims after cutover must use current project-bound Protocol 2 role packages. Existing messages/artifacts remain immutable evidence and are not rewritten. Cross-project writes remain denied; transaction/human-approval boundaries remain unchanged.
